Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) BVFCL possesses only the existing assembly drawings and general arrangement drawings of the slewing gearbox assembly, brake drum coupling and slewing drive assembly. Complete manufact uring drawings, detailed technical specifications and dimensional data required for manufacture ar e not available. Therefore, the bidder shall visit the site (Bagging–III Plant), inspect the existing ins tallation, verify all dimensions and collect all necessary technical information before submission of the offer. No claim on account of insufficient drawings, dimensions or technical information shall b e entertained after submission of the bid. 2) The successful bidder shall prepare complete manufacturing drawings and design details based

on the available reference drawings, site measurements and its own engineering assessment. Sub mission or approval of drawings by BVFCL shall be limited to interface verification only and shall n ot relieve the supplier of responsibility for correctness of design, dimensions, fitment, performance or interchangeability. 3) The newly supplied gearbox assembly and accessories must be fully interchangeable with the e xisting system without any modification in the foundation, mounting, or alignment. The party shall furnish Interchangeability certificate to this effect along with supply. 4) The supplier shall guarantee that the supplied items will perform satisfactorily under the existin g operating conditions of the plant. Any defect or mismatch arising out of design, material, or work manship shall be rectified/replaced by the supplier at no extra cost. 5) The supplier shall provide technical assistance during trial run and commissioning, if required, t o ensure smooth operation and proper fitment of the supplied items. 6) The supplied gearbox, brake drum coupling, and thrustor brake shall carry a minimum warranty of 12 months from the date of commissioning or 18 months from the date of supply, whichever is earlier. The party shall furnish guarantee certificate along with supply. 7) Complete unit shall be suitably packed to avoid any damage during transit, handling and for lon g period storage. 8) Payment shall be made in 30 days after receipt and acceptance of materials at site.
